abilities.name: defiant
abilities.effect: Raises Attack two stages upon having any stat lowered.

kanto.flavorText: The plant stalk it holds is its weapon. The stalk is used like a sword to cut all sorts of things.

original-johto.flavorText: In order to pre­ vent their extinction, more people have made an effort to breed these POKéMON.

hoenn.flavorText: It is always seen with a stick from a plant. Apparently, there are good sticks and bad sticks. This POKéMON occasionally fights with others over choice sticks.

original-sinnoh.flavorText: It can’t live without the stalk it holds. That’s why it defends the stalk from attackers with its life.

extended-sinnoh.flavorText: It can’t live without the stalk it holds. That’s why it defends the stalk from attackers with its life.

updated-johto.flavorText: If it eats the plant stalk it carries as emergency rations, it runs off in search of a new stalk.

original-unova.flavorText: It can’t live without the stalk it holds. That’s why it defends the stalk from attackers with its life.

updated-unova.flavorText: It can’t live without the stalk it holds. That’s why it defends the stalk from attackers with its life.

kalos.flavorText: It always walks about with a plant stalk clamped in its beak. The stalk is used for building its nest.

updated-hoenn.flavorText: Farfetch’d is always seen with a stalk from a plant of some sort. Apparently, there are good stalks and bad stalks. This Pokémon has been known to fight with others over stalks.

letsgo-kanto.flavorText: They live where reedy plants grow. Farfetch’d are rarely seen, so it’s thought their numbers are decreasing.

swsh.flavorText: They use a plant stalk as a weapon, but not all of them use it in the same way. Several distinct styles of stalk fighting have been observed.
